# Backgrounds (15)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **aurora-background** (AuroraBackground): Soft, slowly drifting aurora light made of blurred token-colored glows with fine vertical curtains and an optional radial fade. Not for: Behind dense content or data.
- **beams-background** (BeamsBackground): Hairline rails with thin light beams rising along them and dissolving near the top, over a soft glow. Not for: Behind long text or tables.
- **cover-art** (CoverArt): Cover pictures drawn from a seed in your theme's chart colors: color fields, rings, bars, dots or waves. Not for: A real photograph or logo (use media).
- **dot-pattern** (DotPattern): A lightweight SVG dot grid background with an optional radial fade and a few softly pulsing glow dots. Not for: When you want visible motion as the focal point (use flickering-grid or beams-background).
- **flickering-grid** (FlickeringGrid): A canvas grid of small squares that flicker at random brightness, like a busy status board. Not for: Behind small or low-contrast text (keep maxOpacity low or add a scrim).
- **globe** (Globe): An interactive WebGL dot globe (cobe) with markers, drag-to-spin momentum and arrow-key control. Not for: Precise geographic data or choropleths (use a real map library).
- **grid-pattern** (GridPattern): A crisp square-grid background in the border color with optional dashed lines, filled cells, softly lighting random cells and an edge fade, drawn as one SVG pattern. Not for: Dots (dot-pattern).
- **interactive-grid** (InteractiveGrid): A canvas grid whose cells light up under the pointer and fade out behind it, leaving a glowing trail, drawn only while something is moving and listening on its parent so… Not for: Touch-only audiences (there is no hover).
- **light-rays** (LightRays): Soft beams of theme-colored light fanning down from the top edge, each swaying and breathing at its own pace, deterministic so the server and browser match. Not for: Light backgrounds with dark text at high intensity.
- **meteors** (Meteors): Thin meteors with glowing heads and fading tails streak across a container at a set angle. Not for: Dense UI or data tables.
- **noise-texture** (NoiseTexture): A film-grain layer made from an SVG turbulence filter, with strength, fineness, blend mode and an optional shimmer, to take the plastic edge off gradients, cards and… Not for: Text-heavy surfaces at high opacity.
- **particles** (Particles): A canvas field of softly twinkling particles with depth, gentle drift and a pointer that attracts or repels them. Not for: Behind long-form text.
- **retro-grid** (RetroGrid): A perspective floor of grid lines gliding toward you under a glowing horizon, tinted with any theme color, tilt and cell size adjustable, still under reduced motion. Not for: Dense UI behind small text.
- **ripple** (Ripple, ClickRipple): Concentric rings that breathe outward as a background, plus a press ripple that spreads from the pointer (or the center for keyboard) on any surface. Not for: Standard buttons (the Ballmac button already has press feedback).
- **warp-background** (WarpBackground): A hyperspace tunnel of streaks flying out from the center on a canvas, in theme colors with a soft vignette for readable content, parallax toward the pointer, pausing… Not for: Content-heavy pages.
